title: Water cycle: states and qualifications

input.text:
Water cycle: this is a contributor-authored summary based on USGS water-science material, not a complete textbook.
Evaporation changes liquid water into gaseous water, or water vapor. Energy is needed, but evaporation can occur without the water boiling; it is not restricted to 100 degrees Celsius.
Condensation changes water vapor into liquid water. Water vapor itself is invisible to the human eye; visible tiny liquid droplets in a cloud must not be equated with the gas.
Water in clouds may return to the surface as precipitation in liquid or solid form. Not every cloud produces rain.
This brief supplies no local weather forecast, universal process duration, global percentage or controlled experimental temperature. State the information gap rather than inventing exact figures.
